scenes.title: Snowy cottage · daylight
scenes.description: One lovely modest timber-and-stone cottage in a quiet snowy conifer forest, a believable pitched roof with thick rounded snow, a stone chimney with a fine plume of smoke drifting naturally, soft winter daytime light, muted honey wood and pale blue snow shadows. House at upper-right at middle distance, snowy foreground, pine and cedar trees genuinely laden with snow. No people, tracks, decorations or oversized fantasy architecture.

scenes.title: Snowy cottage · windowlight
scenes.description: A lovely modest timber-and-stone cottage, thick snow on its pitched roof and surrounding conifers, nighttime deep blue and charcoal forest. Warm amber light FROM WITHIN shines through windows and lights a small patch of untouched snow immediately outside; thin realistic smoke rising from stone chimney. Interior windowlight is the main warm source, faint moonlight outlines snow. Dark scene stays upper-right; pale ivory left and bottom remain light-mode-safe. No people, tracks, decorations, exterior lanterns or fantasy architecture.

scenes.title: Snowfall at the window
scenes.description: Quiet arched fireplace with small flame, a narrow window at extreme right showing soft snowfall on cedar; warm ivory interior meets faint blue winter exterior, muted gentle light.

scenes.title: Snowy forest · low sun
scenes.description: A calm peaceful conifer forest with ground and trees covered in thick untouched snow. No structures and no water. A small LOW WINTER SUN is visibly shining through the distant trees near the horizon at upper-right, casting long soft blue-gray tree shadows FROM the horizon TOWARDS THE CAMERA across foreground snow. Restrained pale butter-gold sunlight, fluffy white snow on cedar and fir boughs, gently layered forest depth. No people or footprints, no impossible rays or inconsistent shadow directions.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · daylight
scenes.description: A small non-frozen stream winds naturally through a peaceful forest covered in thick untouched snow. Flowing water is visibly open dark teal and clear blue-gray, soft gentle ripples; broad thick snowy banks, snow-capped stones and snowy fir/cedar branches. Cool diffuse winter DAYLIGHT with subtle blue-gray shadows. Stream curves through the upper-right scene towards lower-right foreground, visually coherent flowing channel, no tracks or people, no frozen surface or ice over stream, no houses.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · sunset
scenes.description: A small non-frozen stream winds through a peaceful conifer forest with thick untouched snow covering banks, stones and branches. Clearly open flowing dark teal water with restrained copper, gold and blush sunset reflections. Warm SUNSET horizon between trees, coral-peach sky at upper-right, warm light brushing snowy treetops, deep blue-violet shadows on snow. Stream curves naturally towards lower-right foreground, no ice over flowing surface, no people, no tracks, no houses.

scenes.title: Hearth · firelight and moonlight
scenes.description: The approved nighttime variation of Wednesday's scene: same arched plaster hearth, small seed-stem vase, stacked logs and narrow window with snowy evergreen outside. Dark charcoal/indigo interior lit mainly by amber firelight and faint cool moonlight through the window. No daytime sun circle, no electric lights; visible candle unlit. Same composition as Wednesday, pale far-left text area and bottom fade for light-mode UI.

scenes.title: Snowy cottage · pink dawn

Warm window glow still visible, fine chimney smoke. The sun is not yet above the horizon.

scenes.title: Snowy forest · silver fog
scenes.description: A forest of tall snow-laden firs and cedars in thick silver winter morning fog. Layered trunks recede into mist; diffused pearly light, no visible sun. Heavy rounded untouched snowdrifts. Make the atmospheric lighting substantially different from the original golden sun.

scenes.title: Ridgefield swans · misty dawn
scenes.description: Ridgefield wetland and snowy auto-tour road at earliest dawn: a thin pink strip on the horizon, lavender predawn sky, dark open unfrozen wetland with low delicate mist and graceful winter swans swimming quietly. Snowy bare trees and reeds, cool lavender snow. Preserve believable open water; no frozen pond.

scenes.title: Snowy cottage · evening snowfall
scenes.description: The same lovely snowy woodland cottage during thick active snowfall at early evening: overcast slate-gray and violet atmosphere, snowflakes against evergreen trees, deep fresh snow, no moon or stars. Amber light from within its windows is the main warm source and illuminates a little snow immediately outside. Fine chimney smoke blends into falling snow.

scenes.title: Hearth · blue predawn
scenes.description: The plaster arched hearth, ceramic vase of dried winter seed stems, stacked logs and narrow window before dawn. Outside is a snowy evergreen forest in subdued cobalt and violet, the first pale rose strip on the horizon, no moon. Low glowing embers and a small fire warm the room; indoor shadows long and quiet. Retain the cozy interior subject and winter outside, pale left and lower margins.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · misty dawn
scenes.description: The unfrozen winding stream through a heavily snow-covered fir forest at blue predawn. Fine mist hovers above flowing dark water, the faintest pale peach dawn begins beyond distant trees. Mostly cool blue and lilac snow, calm dark teal water, no orange sunlight yet. Rich winter texture, rounded untouched snowbanks.

scenes.title: Snowy forest · moonlight
scenes.description: Snow-covered winter conifer forest on a clear moonlit night. A modest full moon high at upper right casts cold silvery highlights and long blue shadows on smooth snowdrifts; snowy firs fade into deep navy distance. Sparse realistic stars, no daylight or sunset glow. Keep the image's far left and bottom pale warm ivory for the app despite the dark painted scene on the right.

scenes.title: Million Dollar Highway · sunrise
scenes.description: The winding Million Dollar Highway in Colorado's snow-covered San Juan Mountains at first sunrise. Packed snow covers the road surface. High rugged mountains catch brilliant warm pink alpenglow while the curved road and conifer slopes remain icy blue in shadow. Pale peach clouds and a sliver of morning gold; sweeping winter mountain landscape, no vehicles or people.

scenes.title: Ridgefield swans · golden sunset
scenes.description: Snow-covered Ridgefield wetland auto-tour route at sunset. Winter swans glide on unfrozen water reflecting gold and copper from low sunset clouds, snowy reeds and bare cottonwoods have amber edges and soft violet shadows. A different arrangement of swimming swans, wide curving road and wetland. Still visibly deep winter, no green meadow or warm-season flowers.

scenes.title: Hearth · stormy winter daylight
scenes.description: The same plaster arched hearth interior on a snowy storm day: muted cool daylight through the narrow window, dense falling snow and snowy evergreen outside, no sun circle painted on the wall. A modest bright fire, soft amber reflection on plaster, translucent silver-blue ambient shadows. Keep dried seed stems, stacked logs, restrained pottery. Quiet and cozy.

scenes.title: Snowy Rainier forest · alpenglow
scenes.description: A variation in a deeply snow-covered Mount Rainier conifer forest just after sunrise, with a distant recognizable snowy volcanic summit visible between tall firs in the upper-right distance. Pink alpenglow on the peak and tree tips; blue-violet shadows in untouched snowdrifts. Peach and pale yellow winter sky, no bare summer ground.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · winter sunbeams
scenes.description: A winter stream in a snow-laden old-growth cedar and fir forest, low late-morning sunshine breaking through mist into visible diagonal shafts across the right-hand scene. Dark clear flowing water reflecting small golden patches, thick smooth snow on rocks and banks, sparkling frost on evergreen needles. New arrangement of tall trunks and cascading stream, unmistakably January winter.

scenes.title: Snowy cottage · blue hour
scenes.description: Snow-covered modest cottage at blue hour shortly after sunset. Steel blue and muted purple sky with a fading pale apricot band far away; no moon yet. Interior windows shine warm amber; conifers and heavy roof snow take blue-violet shadows. Reframe the same cottage a little farther back behind snow-laden branches for a distinct arrangement.

scenes.title: Million Dollar Highway · blue hour
scenes.description: Snow-covered San Juan Mountains and winding Million Dollar Highway in predawn blue hour. Packed white snow on road, deep cobalt and violet mountain shadows, distant snow peaks under thin lilac clouds and a faint pink horizon. No direct sunlight, no vehicles. The snowy road has a distinctly different sweeping curve yet stays believable to this steep mountain route.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · moonlight
scenes.description: A heavily snow-covered forest stream at night with cold clear moonlight. Dark flowing water catches a narrow silver-blue reflection; snowy rocks and fir branches glow softly. Modest moon high among sparse stars in the painted upper-right sky; deep navy forest, no gold sunset. Retain smooth creamy left and bottom fades, not black full-frame.

scenes.title: Hearth · winter sunset
scenes.description: The cozy plaster arched hearth at winter sunset. Outside the narrow window snowy evergreens stand against a rosy orange and lilac sky. Low real sunset light through the window makes a small warm band across the hearth ledge and delicate long shadows of dried seed stems. Small glowing fire and soft room light, no moon, no painted decorative sun circle.

scenes.title: Ridgefield swans · frosty sunbeams
scenes.description: A very frosty January morning at the snowy Ridgefield wetland auto-tour route. Thin winter fog parts under strong low sunlight, several distinct shafts light snow-covered bare branches and frozen reed tips. Swans on open unfrozen blue water at middle distance; low white mist over part of the wetland. A new slightly lower view along the snow-covered road, no leafed trees or spring greenery.

scenes.title: Snowy forest · falling snow
scenes.description: A dense snow-covered conifer forest during active snowfall at midday. Soft overcast gray-blue light, visible fine flakes against deep fir branches, no visible sun or sunbeams. Closely spaced trees under heavy soft white snow, smoothly drifted forest floor; a sheltered intimate woodland composition differing from the open original. Preserve creamy app-safe left and bottom.

scenes.title: San Juan road · clearing storm
scenes.description: A packed-snow mountain road in Colorado's San Juan range as a winter storm clears. Rugged snow-covered mountains partially veiled by fast low storm clouds, one dramatic opening of pale yellow sunlight illuminates a far snowy ridge, foreground road and snowy pines remain cool shadow. Dense snow over all exposed ground. No vehicles, no bare asphalt.

scenes.title: Winter cabin · sunset clearing
scenes.description: A different modest timber-and-stone winter cottage in a snow-covered Cascades forest clearing. Late orange and rose sunset light brushes a deep rounded snow roof and fir branches; windows glow softly, fine smoke rises from a simple stone chimney. Pale mauve and peach clouds, cold blue snow shadows. Believable small cabin, no decorations, no people, no tracks.

scenes.title: Cascade mountain pass · winter sun
scenes.description: A winding packed-snow mountain road through a Washington Cascade mountain pass, new location variation on the snowy mountain highway idea. Dense snow-laden tall firs, broad rugged snowy peaks in upper-right distance, bright clear winter midday sky and white high clouds. Deep untouched snowy banks, crisp cool sunlight and blue shadows, no cars, no bare pavement, no summer vegetation.

scenes.title: Nā Pali sunrise
scenes.description: Fluted emerald ridges and steep green Nā Pali-like Hawaiian sea cliffs above turquoise Pacific water, faint peach sunrise on cliff edges, fine morning clouds. No fish or monstera.

scenes.title: Monstera morning
scenes.description: A close botanical study of two large sculptural split monstera leaves with correct veins and leaf fenestrations; warm morning light and delicate long plant shadows on ivory plaster, small amber circle of light. No coast or fish.

scenes.title: Sunlit reef
scenes.description: A few anatomically correct yellow tangs and small striped butterflyfish in very clear pale aquamarine shallow reef water, fine sunlight caustics and understated coral rock at extreme right; no smiling fish, no clownfish.

scenes.title: Mist along the cliffs
scenes.description: Lush fluted Nā Pali sea cliffs recede into pale marine mist, muted emerald and blue-teal water, a few distant seabird silhouettes naturally scattered; delicate quiet overcast light.

scenes.title: Rain on monstera
scenes.description: One large elegant monstera leaf and a smaller leaf with correct natural splits, softly detailed tiny rain droplets, cool diffused light on pale cream ground; no landscape or fish.

scenes.title: Reef channel
scenes.description: An elevated diagonal view across rounded coral gardens divided by a deeper teal water channel, with reef triggerfish and smaller whitespotted toby puffers rather than Wednesday's yellow tangs and striped fish. No reflective water ceiling; separate coral mounds and short branched/finger corals. Pale left/bottom fade.

scenes.title: Nā Pali sunset
scenes.description: Fluted green coastal ridges above calm Pacific surf, softly luminous pastel peach and pink sunset behind thin clouds, a few distant seabirds, sea glass water. No tropical collage.

scenes.title: Nā Pali · violet predawn
scenes.description: The lush tropical Nā Pali coastline before sunrise. Deep violet and indigo cloud layers over emerald cliffs, a thin coral-pink horizon, ocean in cool dark teal with pale foam. No direct sunshine yet, subtle mist between the deeply fluted green cliffs. Retain warm tropical vegetation and dramatic island geography, no snow or autumn colors.

scenes.title: Hawaiian jungle · morning sunbeams
scenes.description: A lush Hawaiian rainforest hollow at early morning after rain. Low sunshine forms distinct golden shafts through fine mist and layers of huge monstera leaves, climbing variegated pothos, banana leaves, ferns and bright red ginger flowers. Wet foliage catches individual glowing droplets. Shift the arrangement of large leaves and the misty opening so it is a distinct composition, deep green and warm gold.

scenes.title: Nā Pali · rainbow after rain
scenes.description: The lush Nā Pali cliffs in warm afternoon sunshine just after a February tropical shower. Soft rain clouds retreat over the sea, one beautiful natural rainbow arcs in the upper-right sky against pale gray clouds. Sunlit green ridges and sea mist, luminous turquoise water and white surf. A fresh slightly wider overlook framing, no people, boats or buildings.

scenes.title: Hawaiian reef · low sun shafts
scenes.description: A different shallow Hawaiian reef under low early morning sun. Diagonal clear sun shafts penetrate turquoise water to patches of creamy rippled sand between rounded golden corals and dark lava rock. Small vivid yellow tangs and striped reef fish swim in different directions, believable natural scale. Warm flecks of dawn gold at the surface, cool deep teal shadows, a distinct low angle across the reef.

scenes.title: Waimea Canyon · misty dawn
scenes.description: Kauai's colorful Waimea Canyon in quiet early dawn. Layered red and ochre ridges softened by thin lavender mist in the gullies; the first rose light touches only the highest edges while tropical green valley slopes remain cool blue-green shadow. Pale peach, lavender and pink sky with low soft clouds, no hard midday light and no snow.

scenes.title: Nā Pali · moonlit ocean
scenes.description: The dramatic green Nā Pali cliffs on a clear tropical moonlit night. Dark emerald and indigo ridges, silver-blue moonlight on cliff edges, a narrow silver reflection on deep blue ocean and luminous white wave foam. A modest natural full moon and sparse stars in the painted upper-right sky, no sunset glow or daylight. Far-left and bottom still dissolve into pale warm cream for the app.

scenes.title: Hawaiian jungle · blue hour
scenes.description: A dense tropical Hawaiian jungle at blue hour just after sunset. Wet huge monstera leaves, variegated pothos vines, ferns and heliconia flowers in cool teal and indigo shadow with a narrow peach-lit opening in the far canopy. Little residual warm light on a few large upper leaves, rich detailed foliage, tropical fruit remains believable. No magical glowing objects or insects; quiet natural twilight.

scenes.title: Maui black sand · pink dawn
scenes.description: Northeastern Maui black-sand cove at sunrise. Soft pink and peach clouds, early rosy light along wave crests and wet black volcanic sand, cool teal sea in shadow, dark lava rocks framed by warm green tropical coastal trees. A different viewpoint lower along the curved beach, distant lush cliffs veiled in fine mist. No footprints, people, boats or buildings.

scenes.title: Hawaiian turtle · reef twilight
scenes.description: A Hawaiian green sea turtle gliding gently above a coral reef in the last soft light of tropical sunset. The turtle is shown from a different slightly lower angle, warm amber-pink reflections on the rippled surface overhead fading into luminous blue-green water. Muted golden coral, lava rocks and a few small yellow reef fish, dim but visible natural underwater detail, no stars or moon underwater, no glowing fantasy reef.

scenes.title: Waimea Canyon · storm cloudbreak
scenes.description: Waimea Canyon during a clearing tropical rainstorm. Tall slate-gray clouds, a dramatic opening sends broad golden sunbeams onto only some brilliant red-orange canyon walls and green ridges; other ravines remain deep blue-green shadow. Fine mist rises from the wet lush valleys. View from a slightly different overlook with foreground tropical ferns, no snow and no fall-colored trees.

scenes.title: Monstera · evening gold
scenes.description: A close botanical study of huge fenestrated monstera leaves and climbing pothos in low late afternoon Hawaiian sunlight. Light is rich amber-gold, with strongly elongated, crisp leaf shadows on a pale plaster wall and detailed droplets on the glossy leaves. Add a new leaf arrangement, small orange-red heliconia at far right and a small glimpse of lush tropical background, no cold season or dead leaves.

scenes.title: Nā Pali · tropical rain
scenes.description: Nā Pali coastline during a warm tropical February squall. Dark blue-gray clouds and visible rain curtains partly veil distant deeply fluted emerald cliffs, strong foamy waves against black rocks, wet foreground leaves. One soft cool opening in the cloud ceiling adds depth but no rainbow or orange sunset. The setting remains richly green tropical Hawaii, never snowy.

scenes.title: Kauai jungle track · sunset
scenes.description: An overgrown red-clay off-road track through interior Kauai at late sunset. Peach and apricot light catches wet pothos and monstera leaves, ginger flowers, ferns and a few banana leaves, puddles reflect the rosy sky. Tall lush green ridges in the distance with thin violet mist. A slightly lower viewpoint along the winding muddy track, no vehicles or people.

scenes.title: Maui black sand · moonlight
scenes.description: A quiet northeastern Maui black-sand beach on a clear moonlit tropical night. Silver-white curling wave foam, deep cobalt water, glossy dark volcanic sand with a slender reflected moon track, black lava rocks and green tropical tree silhouettes. A modest moon above layered coastal ridges and a few stars at upper right; no bioluminescence or glowing fantasy effects. Preserve the pale ivory left and bottom fade despite the night setting.

scenes.title: Hawaiian reef · sunlit lava arch
scenes.description: A new Hawaiian underwater reef location with a small believable natural lava-rock arch on the right, golden rounded corals along its base and patches of rippled pale sand. Clear turquoise sunbeams enter from the surface; small yellow tangs, striped butterflyfish and one tasteful Hawaiian triggerfish swim around the arch. Not a cave full of darkness: bright, airy detailed underwater watercolor with natural fish anatomy and sizes.

scenes.title: February 29 · dolphins leap beneath a rainbow
scenes.description: Create the extra-special February 29 scene, a joyful natural Hawaiian 'leap day'. This image uses the reference only for watercolor style and Nā Pali geography; replace the main composition with a small group of three natural spinner dolphins joyfully leaping from brilliant turquoise ocean in front of distant lush green Nā Pali cliffs. One dolphin is airborne in a graceful twisting leap, one lower arc nearby and one just breaking the surface; anatomically credible sleek gray dolphins, no anthropomorphic smiles or clothing. Sparkling white splashes, soft golden sunlight after a tropical shower, one vivid beautiful rainbow in the upper-right sky, peach-white clouds and emerald cliffs. Dolphins clearly visible in the right-hand painted area at a lively but believable scale. Make this noticeably more playful and celebratory than the regular monthly images while retaining the refined natural watercolor style and pale creamy left/bottom fades. No text, numbers, people, boats or decorations.

scenes.title: Ice cave · sunrise
scenes.description: A new shallow, broad, low-ceilinged glacier chamber with an asymmetrical long horizontal mouth opening onto a snowy flat horizon. A small visible sun touches the horizon through the opening, casting orange-red dawn light across rippled blue ice walls and the foreground floor. Different cave structure from Tuesday and Thursday.

scenes.title: Sunlit cyan ice
scenes.description: Sunlight passing through a sculptural glacial ice arch makes vivid jewel-like cyan and turquoise scallops, luminous pale snow reflections, delicate trapped bubbles. Bright natural translucency, not neon plastic.

scenes.title: Ice cave · aurora night
scenes.description: A new tall, twisting glacier side-chamber with a narrow irregular vertical opening, fluted ice walls and a rounded foreground ice buttress. Deep teal/indigo night, aurora visible in the exterior sky through the opening, subtly reflected in the ice. Different structure from Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.

scenes.title: Soft blue chamber
scenes.description: A broad undulating blue-ice chamber with pale silvery diffuse winter light, layered rounded frozen water forms, a little lilac-blue shadow and pristine snow floor. No lava or volcanic rock.

scenes.title: Aurora · green and cyan
scenes.description: Natural graceful green and cyan aurora curtains above a quiet Icelandic snow-covered ridge and icy-water reflections. Dark indigo sky only at upper-right; white left and pale bottom remain calm.

scenes.title: Aurora · violet and pink
scenes.description: Different graceful aurora curtain silhouette with soft violet and dusty pink light plus thin pale green lower rays over Icelandic snowy terrain and reflective icy water; natural realistic winter landscape.

scenes.title: Aurora · red and magenta
scenes.description: Unmistakable high-altitude red/ruby/magenta northern-light curtains above thin pale green lower rays over snowy Icelandic ground. Red is light in sky, not lava or fire; restrained luminous fine rays, indigo sky at far right.

scenes.title: Ice cave · violet dawn
scenes.description: A newly composed Icelandic glacial ice chamber viewed from a low position, intricate scalloped cobalt and cyan ceiling overhead on the right; broad opening frames snow-covered volcanic ground and a distant ocean at violet predawn. Thin peach band near horizon, no sun disk yet, cold blue light reveals transparent facets and pale snow. Distinct arch shape and small frozen pool, not the reference sunrise.

scenes.title: Ice cave · clear winter noon
scenes.description: A tall narrow Icelandic blue-ice passage opens onto brilliantly snow-covered hills beneath a clear winter blue sky. Crisp low midday sunlight refracts through translucent cyan ice along the opening, white frost seams and tiny bubbles in deep blue ceiling. Fresh angled perspective looking outward around a curving icy wall; no orange sunrise, people, or artificial illumination.

scenes.title: Ice cave · moonlit shore
scenes.description: An Icelandic ice cave with a broad irregular low arch looks out to a snowy black volcanic shoreline under natural moonlight. One modest moon outside at upper-right, silver reflections on a dark still tidal pool, deep blue/cyan ice facets and frost, sparse stars outside only. Clearly nighttime, no aurora, daylight, flames or glowing fantasy crystals. Change the cave geometry and viewpoint substantially.

scenes.title: Ice cave · falling snow
scenes.description: An Icelandic blue glacial chamber at a snowy overcast daytime. Through a high irregular ice opening on the right, see softly falling snow over icy boulders and distant snowy ridges. Turquoise floor ice, intensely detailed cobalt roof with clear trapped bubbles, gray diffuse light, no sun or aurora. A different intimate branching chamber and near foreground ice ledge.

scenes.title: Aurora · emerald snowfields
scenes.description: An open snowy Icelandic mountain valley on a clear winter night. A long natural green and cyan aurora arcs diagonally over the right-hand sky, tiny stars, distant snowy volcanic ridges and smooth undisturbed snowdrifts with dark lava boulders at right. Faint green reflections on ice in a narrow frozen stream. No cave, trees, structures or daylight, no fantasy neon glow in the landscape.

scenes.title: Aurora · violet over the lagoon
scenes.description: A wintry Icelandic glacial lagoon at night with low blue icebergs floating in dark still open water among snowy margins. Natural curtains of violet and pink aurora sweep above the distant glacier on the right; stars and subtle soft aurora reflection in water, glacier ice a believable cold blue. Low shoreline viewpoint, distinct iceberg silhouettes. No cave, people, boats or tropical colors.

scenes.title: Aurora · crimson above basalt
scenes.description: A remote Icelandic snow-covered coast at nighttime with dark jagged basalt rocks and a distant snowy headland. Natural high-altitude red and magenta aurora drapes softly across a deep indigo starry sky, a slender green band near the horizon, silver foam on a cold deep blue sea. Airy physically believable atmosphere, no cave, trees, buildings or fiery lava.

scenes.title: Thermal hills · lavender dawn
scenes.description: Snow-covered Icelandic geothermal hills before sunrise. Many substantial natural white steam plumes curl from vents in rusty ochre earth among thick snowfields and volcanic ridges. Lavender and indigo shadows in snow, quiet rose-peach dawn clouds at upper-right, no sun disk. New rolling valley viewpoint, very wintery, no vegetation, infrastructure or people.

scenes.title: Thermal hills · winter cloudbreak
scenes.description: A snow-covered Icelandic geothermal hillside after a passing snow squall, broad shafts of low winter gold light illuminate heavy white steam against dark slate clouds. Ochre fumarole ground, thick snowy banks, winding mineral stream through the right-hand valley, distant volcanic ridge. Strong natural contrast, snow dominant, no lava, summer plants or buildings.

scenes.title: Gullfoss · frosty blue hour
scenes.description: Gullfoss in Iceland at winter blue hour just after sunset, recognizable broad two-tier waterfall turns into the narrow canyon on the right. Thick snow and ice on banks and ledges, portions of waterfall remain flowing dark teal-white, billowing cold spray. Pale violet sky fading to indigo with residual pink near horizon, no rainbow in absence of direct sunshine. Fresh wider side viewpoint.

scenes.title: Gullfoss · silver winter night
scenes.description: Snowy partly frozen Gullfoss under a modest clear winter moon. Natural silvery moonlight catches enormous ice-covered ledges and white water plunging into the canyon; flowing river dark blue-teal, distant snowy plateau in deep cobalt. Fine suspended mist, stars sparse, no daylight or aurora. Distinct lower diagonal overlook showing both waterfall tiers and canyon bend.

scenes.title: Icelandic horses · rose sunrise
scenes.description: Several distant Icelandic horses with shaggy winter coats on a snow-covered hillside in low rose sunrise light. Natural small animal scale, one chestnut and two dark horses standing separately near black volcanic stones, snowy volcanic ridges far behind, pale pink and lavender clouds. New hillside arrangement and view, no fences, people, saddle, buildings or green summer grass.

scenes.title: Icelandic horses · quiet snowfall
scenes.description: A few distant shaggy Icelandic horses partially veiled by soft active snowfall on a rolling white winter hillside. Muted chestnut and charcoal coats, horses naturally grazing where sparse tawny grass pokes through snow. Overcast blue-gray light, low snowy mountain ridges, distinct view with horses further right and spread apart. No dramatic close-up animals, trees, buildings or people.

scenes.title: Seljalandsfoss · frosty morning
scenes.description: Seljalandsfoss waterfall seen from outside in Iceland on a crisp snowy winter morning. Narrow tall white cascade descends over an overhanging dark basalt cliff, icicles and thick snow cover cliff base and foreground; low pale golden light touches spray and snow edges. Pool visibly flowing and blue-green, winter sky clear icy blue. New side view from a snowy slope, no rainbow, people, path structures or warm-season grass.

scenes.title: Seljalandsfoss · snowy afternoon
scenes.description: An intimate side view of Iceland's Seljalandsfoss during overcast active winter snowfall. The slender cascade drops beside a dark curved rock recess, long natural icicles and broad thick snowfields surround open blue-gray water. Soft diffuse light, slate clouds, a few weathered basalt rocks near the snowy foreground. Strongly distinct viewpoint from crimson-sunset original, no sun or autumn foliage.

scenes.title: Brúarfoss · low winter sunlight
scenes.description: Brúarfoss in Iceland, naturally brilliant cyan glacial water cascading through many channels in black volcanic rock under low golden winter sunshine. Thick snow caps rocks and banks, frost crystals and a few bare low twigs at far right. A closer downstream oblique viewpoint emphasizes the central blue channel; peach and pale blue winter sky, no trees in leaf or green summer moss.

scenes.title: Strokkur · blue-hour eruption
scenes.description: Strokkur geyser erupting naturally above a snowy Icelandic geothermal basin at blue hour before sunrise. Large white-blue water jet and heavy steam plume on the right against deep violet-gray sky, warm peach line low at the horizon, distant snowy hills. Snowy rust-colored ground around the open steaming turquoise pool, no buildings, people or artificial lights.

scenes.title: Strokkur · sunset steam
scenes.description: A different tall erupting Strokkur geyser plume backlit by rich low golden sunset light in a snowy Icelandic geothermal landscape. White steam and water become delicate gold at the edges, cold indigo shadows over thick snow, ochre wet ground beside a rippling turquoise hot pool, dark far snowy ridges and pink-orange clouds. Lower and wider viewpoint than original, no people, buildings or summer vegetation.

scenes.title: High Line Chelsea Morning
scenes.description: On the High Line in Chelsea on a clear May morning: elevated concrete path curves gently past preserved rust-colored railway tracks set into lush spring planting; adjacent red-brick warehouse facades with old black fire escapes and a few contemporary buildings, fresh tree leaves, delicate white flowers and lilac-purple perennials. Low oblique morning light makes long natural shadows; an intimate city garden perspective rather than a skyline panorama.

scenes.title: High Line After Spring Rain
scenes.description: The High Line after a May shower at late afternoon: low viewpoint beside two old steel rails threading between fresh grasses, a dark wooden bench on the right, glistening concrete paving with a few small puddles, dense spring planting, brick Chelsea buildings beyond. A peach sunbreak under blue-gray clouds, reflections and wet leaves rendered with fine natural detail. Quiet, no close-up people.

scenes.title: High Line Tenth Avenue Overlook
scenes.description: The High Line's Tenth Avenue Square overlook in May: broad warm wooden amphitheater steps descend on the right toward a large street-facing glass opening, showing the long perspective of Tenth Avenue, yellow taxis tiny and distant, layered brick architecture, young spring trees around the elevated park. Bright pale late-morning sunlight and elegant architectural lines, distinctly an urban overlook, not another planted footpath.

scenes.title: High Line Birch Grove
scenes.description: Within a leafy birch grove along the High Line in May: slender white-barked birch trunks, pale fresh green canopy, fern-like ground planting and spring flowers, a narrow elevated boardwalk bending into deep right background; partial glimpses of Chelsea brick buildings through foliage. Beautiful dappled afternoon sunlight, intimate calm sheltered composition, precisely detailed bark and leaves.

scenes.title: High Line Hudson Sunset
scenes.description: From the High Line's northern Rail Yards curve in May: elevated walkway and black railings sweep through the lower right toward the Hudson River, soft green spring planting and preserved rail lines; distant river piers and New Jersey shore visible across blue-gold water, warm red-orange sunset sky and subtle modern west-side buildings on the far right. Wide westward view, beautiful spacious sky and river, believable city scale.

scenes.title: High Line Beneath The Standard
scenes.description: High Line in the Meatpacking District just after sunset in May: elevated garden walkway passes beneath the lifted hotel structure of The Standard, its distinct concrete legs and rectilinear facade in the upper right, warm little walkway lamps beginning to glow among soft leafy planting; surrounding historic low brick buildings, violet-blue evening atmosphere with lingering pink sky. Detailed architectural painting, quiet, no readable signage.

scenes.title: High Line Gansevoort Spring
scenes.description: The southern Gansevoort end of the High Line in May: angular museum architecture in the background at right and an elevated path leading past generous spring foliage, white-blossoming trees and weathered industrial steel, a visible outdoor stair descending toward the historic Meatpacking District's low brick streets. Fresh crisp morning light and pale blue sky, city layers and planted park, distinct from the meadow scene.

scenes.title: DUMBO Washington Street Morning
scenes.description: The iconic Washington Street view in DUMBO, Brooklyn, on a fresh May morning: handsome old red-brick warehouse buildings on both sides of the narrow cobblestone street frame the blue steel Manhattan Bridge tower in the center-right distance; the Empire State Building subtly visible through the arch at believable faraway scale. Fresh green street trees soften the masonry; gentle clear sunlight and long street perspective. No large close vehicles or readable signs.

scenes.title: DUMBO Pebble Beach After Rain
scenes.description: At DUMBO's Pebble Beach after a May rain shower: smooth wet pebbles and shallow little wavelets in the right foreground, the East River opens toward lower Manhattan, the Manhattan Bridge crosses diagonally through the upper right with accurate blue steel structure, soft gray-lavender sky lifting into a luminous sunbreak. Natural river reflections, fresh green shoreline trees; peaceful intimate waterside view, finely painted details.

scenes.title: DUMBO Carousel At Sunrise
scenes.description: From Empire Fulton Ferry park in DUMBO at a pink May sunrise: Jane's Carousel seen from outside as a small elegant glass pavilion with faintly visible painted carousel horses, its glass reflecting rose-gold light; fresh spring trees and a stone riverside path at right, Brooklyn Bridge stone tower and suspension cables rising behind it, lower Manhattan across the East River. Quiet before opening, charming and architectural; no text.

scenes.title: DUMBO Manhattan Bridge Archway
scenes.description: Inside DUMBO's monumental Manhattan Bridge stone archway in soft May daylight: a high masonry arch and textured stone piers frame a view of a small brick courtyard and leafy trees beyond; warm oblique light across old stone, subtle red-brick industrial facades, old paving in the foreground. Calm historic architectural scene, intricate mortar and stone textures, no shop signs or crowd, no subway train.

scenes.title: DUMBO Warehouse Blue Hour
scenes.description: A quiet DUMBO cobblestone street at blue hour in May: elegant red-brick warehouse facades with tall divided windows, subtle warm interior lights, black metal fire escapes and gently lit sidewalk; a partial blue steel bridge span visible high in the far right distance between buildings. Fresh green leaves, faint damp reflections on cobbles, rich indigo twilight with peach on horizon. Preserve fine architecture and quiet mood, no lettering.

scenes.title: Williamsburg Domino Park Afternoon
scenes.description: Domino Park in Williamsburg on a clear May afternoon: distinctive preserved turquoise industrial gantry cranes and refinery machinery beside the East River, warm timber waterfront decking and carefully planted green spring gardens in the right foreground; old red-brick Domino refinery building with its modern glass addition at right, Manhattan skyline across water. Refined realistic geometry, relaxed sunny riverfront atmosphere, no legible signs.

scenes.title: Williamsburg Bushwick Inlet Sunset
scenes.description: From the grassy waterfront of Bushwick Inlet Park in Williamsburg in May: fresh spring grass and low wildflower planting on the right foreground slope, a simple waterside path and dark railing, expansive East River reflecting a coral-lavender sunset, Manhattan's midtown skyline beyond. Natural skyline scale and soft atmospheric distance, lovely quiet contemplative urban landscape, different shoreline angle from Brooklyn Bridge Park.

scenes.title: Williamsburg Side Street Spring
scenes.description: A quiet Williamsburg residential side street in May: varied low red-brick row houses, aged painted masonry, dark metal stoops and fire escapes, a corner with a small green-leafed tree and flowering planters; a few subtle distant modern buildings behind the historic neighborhood. Gentle overcast morning light, warm brick and cool green leaves, intimate human-scale streetscape without store signs or close-up people.

scenes.title: Williamsburg Ferry Landing Twilight
scenes.description: North Williamsburg East River ferry landing just after sunset in May: a modest pier with black railings and a small white ferry in the middle distance, leafy waterfront park and wooden promenade in the right foreground; Manhattan's illuminated skyline reflected softly on dark blue river water, a lavender-pink band on the horizon. Quiet accurate-scale cityscape, no huge fantasy buildings, no readable text.

scenes.title: Williamsburg Bridge At Dawn
scenes.description: Williamsburg Bridge in May at pale golden dawn, viewed from the Brooklyn waterfront near its approach: distinct steel suspension tower, red-painted structural and pedestrian details, diagonally receding bridge deck across the East River; leafy spring branches frame the upper right, low old brick buildings at the right edge. Fine believable cables and steelwork, rose light on metal and calm silvery river, no traffic close-ups.

scenes.title: Brooklyn Heights Promenade Mist
scenes.description: Brooklyn Heights Promenade on a softly misty May morning: elegant dark iron railing and park benches curve away along the upper-right walkway; leafy mature trees and small white spring blossoms, lower Manhattan softened across the East River, glimmering diffuse light in a silvery sky. Quiet beautifully observed scene, old stone paving and bark textures; panorama at a distinctly higher viewpoint than Brooklyn Bridge Park.

scenes.title: Fort Greene Park Spring Sunlight
scenes.description: Fort Greene Park, Brooklyn, on a fresh May afternoon: a sweeping gently sloped park path lined by mature trees in bright spring foliage, sun-dappled grass and subtle flowering shrubs, distant historic Brooklyn brownstones peeking beyond the park on the far right. Lovely layered canopy and peaceful neighborhood character, natural tree scale, finely rendered foliage, no prominent people.

scenes.title: Prospect Park Stone Bridge
scenes.description: Prospect Park in Brooklyn in May: graceful small weathered stone arch bridge spanning a quiet stream on the upper right, dense fresh woodland foliage and fern banks, subtle spring blossoms, gentle water reflections and mottled afternoon light filtering through trees. Believable intimate Brooklyn park scene, nature mixed with historic masonry; no waterfalls, no fantasy castle, no people.

scenes.title: Park Slope Brownstone Evening
scenes.description: Park Slope, Brooklyn, in May at the last light of evening: a corner perspective of handsome brownstone townhouses with broad stone stoops, ornate dark ironwork and flowering window boxes, deep green street-tree canopy above, a soft rose sky between rooflines and a few warm interior lights. Different layout from the earlier sunny brownstone image: corner intersection viewed diagonally across the quiet street, amber and violet dusk, detailed masonry and branches.

scenes.title: Coastal sunrise
scenes.description: Oregon Coast dark sea stacks and Pacific surf with pale peach sunrise breaking through marine cloud, distant headland and fine foreground dune grass, a few very small seabirds.

scenes.title: Foggy headland
scenes.description: Layered misty Oregon headlands, a natural offshore sea stack half-shrouded in white marine fog, quiet blue-gray surf and small driftwood at edge; very airy muted atmosphere.

scenes.title: Secret cove · passing showers
scenes.description: A new elevated southern Oregon cove view inspired by Secret Beach, with uneven tree-topped sea-stack clusters and forested bluffs. Sunlit turquoise surf beside dark passing showers, a clear rainbow in falling rain, separate wispy virga fading above the sea.

scenes.title: Tidepool garden
scenes.description: An intimate oblique close-up of clear Oregon rock tidepools, prominent orange and purple ochre sea stars and open green anemones, textured wet basalt, small mussel/barnacle clusters and fine seaweed. No tropical reef.

scenes.title: Secret cove · fiery sunset
scenes.description: A new low beach-level view inspired by southern Oregon's Secret Beach, with dark tree-capped sea stacks and a forested cove, fiery red-orange-magenta sunset clouds reflected across wet sand and shallow beach water.

scenes.title: Coastal sunset

scenes.title: Cape Kiwanda Morning Surf
scenes.description: Cape Kiwanda on Oregon's coast in June, viewed from a nearby beach at low tide on a clear morning: warm sculpted ochre sandstone headland occupies the right side, foamy Pacific waves sweep around its base, soft golden morning light makes delicate striations in sandstone; dark distant offshore monolith and pale blue sea, wet sand reflections in foreground. scenes.title: Ecola Spruce Viewpoint
scenes.description: A quiet Ecola State Park coastal viewpoint in June: tall Sitka spruce trunks, mossy branches and fern fronds frame a layered view of the Pacific and distant Cannon Beach sea stacks on the right; thin silver marine fog softens headlands, luminous diffused morning light, fresh deep green forest canopy and a natural earth path. Strong depth from finely rendered foreground bark to hazy coast, no people or signs.

scenes.title: Haystack Rock Low Tide
scenes.description: Cannon Beach Haystack Rock in June at a clear low tide, viewed from beach level: the distinctive large dark sea stack stands on the upper right with its smaller neighboring rocks, reflected in a shallow rippled sheet of water on wet sand; natural rounded tidepool rocks and a few modest green anemones in the right foreground, gentle breakers farther out, pale peach morning clouds with clear blue sky. Believable Oregon coastline, delicate realistic water reflections, no people.

scenes.title: Seal Rock Tidepool Details
scenes.description: An intimate oblique low-tide view at Seal Rock on the Oregon coast in June: beautifully clear rock pools in rough wet basalt, prominent natural emerald-green anemones open underwater, a small orange ochre sea star and a purple ochre sea star attached to nearby rock, tiny barnacles, mussel shells, wisps of olive seaweed and fine rippling reflections. Soft cool overcast light reveals exquisite textures. Pacific surf is only a soft sliver in far right background; no tropical corals or colorful fish.

scenes.title: Yaquina Head Clear Afternoon
scenes.description: Yaquina Head on the Oregon coast on a clear June afternoon: the tall slender white historic lighthouse sits on a green headland in the upper right at believable middle distance, dark basalt cliffs and a cove with smooth black cobbles below, turquoise-gray Pacific breakers, a few small seabirds in the air. Crisp sea breeze, fresh grassy headland and blue-white clouds. Accurately simple lighthouse silhouette, fine geology and surf detail, no visitors or text.

scenes.title: Cape Meares Marine Fog
scenes.description: Cape Meares in June at the edge of a rolling marine-fog bank: a modest short white historic lighthouse is tucked beside dark coastal spruce in the upper right, steep green forested headland descends to rugged Pacific rocks and muted blue-gray water; shafts of late afternoon sunlight barely break through pale fog and illuminate one cliff edge. Quiet, believable lighthouse scale, layered airy fog, finely painted forest details, no fantasy architecture or readable signs.

scenes.title: Hug Point Coastal Waterfall
scenes.description: Hug Point on the Oregon coast in June: a small slender freshwater waterfall trickles over a low layered sandstone cliff at the right onto a quiet wet beach, green ferns and coastal vegetation above, a shallow reflective stream curves naturally across smooth dark sand toward Pacific surf beyond. Soft morning marine mist, pale cool sky, muted golden sandstone and detailed silky water. Keep the waterfall modest and believable, not a giant inland cascade; no people.

scenes.title: Boardman Natural Bridges Sunbreak
scenes.description: Samuel H. Boardman coast in southern Oregon in June, viewed from a forested bluff: a rugged natural rock bridge and steep tree-crowned coastal formations occupy the right side, deep teal Pacific water and white foamy channels below, mature wind-shaped conifers with fresh green foliage, fern fronds in foreground. A clear afternoon sunbreak after light rain illuminates the rock and tops of trees; distant cool mist. Natural geology, no fantasy multiple arches or human bridges.

scenes.title: Bandon Face Rock Twilight
scenes.description: Bandon's Face Rock shoreline in June at lingering blue hour: recognizable rugged sea-stack silhouettes rise on the right, the reclining face-like profile subtle and natural, shallow receding water and wet dark sand reflect bands of pink-lavender cloud after sunset. A low foamy wave catches faint silver-blue light, quiet atmospheric Pacific coast, no stars over a bright daytime sky and no people. The left/bottom paper fade stays pale cool blue-white despite the dusk scene.

scenes.title: Oceanside Three Arch Rocks
scenes.description: Oceanside on the Oregon coast in June under soft coastal mist: three distinct rocky offshore formations stand at natural middle distance to the upper right, Pacific waves curl around them, low marine fog drifts across the water, muted green forested bluff and a little beach grass on the extreme right foreground. Pale blue and pearly gray light, subtle blush on the distant horizon, restrained luminous mood; no invented enormous arch carved through every rock.

scenes.title: Cape Arago Harbor Seals
scenes.description: A calm rocky inlet near Cape Arago in June: a small loose group of realistically proportioned harbor seals rests naturally on low wet shoreline rocks on the right at medium distance, gray spotted coats with restrained detail, cool blue-green sea and gentle white surf behind them, coastal spruce and mossy cliff in the far right background. Beautiful soft morning light, quiet wildlife landscape; no crowded colony, no cartoon faces, no giant close-up animal, no people.

scenes.title: Yachats Basalt And Silver Waves
scenes.description: The rocky shoreline at Yachats in June during a clearing shower: dark angular basalt shelves in the right foreground, white Pacific surf pours through narrow natural channels and catches silver sunlight, turbulent turquoise-gray sea beyond and dramatic blue-gray clouds lifting into a luminous sunbreak; delicate low rainbow just in sea spray where light is physically believable. Fine wet-rock texture and detailed foam, forceful natural coast rather than tropical blue water, no people.

scenes.title: Neskowin Proposal Rock Sunset
scenes.description: Neskowin in June at low evening light: forest-topped Proposal Rock stands on the right at natural shoreline scale, a shallow winding creek crosses broad wet sand toward the Pacific, reflections of fresh green trees and peach-rose sky form graceful patterns in the foreground, gentle surf beyond. Intimate peaceful beach perspective and warm sunset scene colors while the blank left/bottom fade remains June's cool blue-white. No people or buildings.

scenes.title: Boardman Forested Cove After Rain
scenes.description: Southern Oregon coast in Samuel H. Boardman corridor just after gentle June rain: an intimate forested cove viewed between moss-covered spruce trunks and richly detailed ferns, dark tree-topped offshore rock formations and bright turquoise surf on the right, wet branches glisten in a soft afternoon sunbreak, fine wisps of fog over the sea. Dense green temperate coastal rainforest, natural layered depth, no jungle fruit, no tropical palms, no people.

scenes.title: Cape Perpetua High Coastal Vista
scenes.description: From a high forested viewpoint at Cape Perpetua in June: the rugged Oregon coastline sweeps away in graceful layers on the right, mature green spruce forest on steep slopes, white wave lines and dark shoreline basalt far below, rolling ribbons of marine fog over the Pacific under a clear upper blue sky. Bright but gentle early-morning light, an airy expansive elevated coastal panorama, finely observed conifers in right foreground, no people or road traffic.

scenes.title: Newport Sea Lions And Fishing Boats
scenes.description: Newport's working harbor on Oregon's coast in June, seen at dock level: a group of realistically proportioned California sea lions with brown and golden coats lounges naturally on wooden floating docks in the right foreground amongst moored fishing boats. Finely rendered weathered planks, ropes, fenders, colorful fishing hulls and tall rigging reflected in calm blue-green Yaquina Bay, soft golden morning light and a little marine haze, a hint of waterfront buildings at natural middle distance. Lively coastal harbor, realistic animal anatomy and scale, no cartoon faces, no oversized animals, no readable lettering, no crowds.

scenes.title: Paradise · Rainier
scenes.description: Mount Rainier from the Paradise area in summer, its broad recognizable glaciated volcanic massif above rolling subalpine meadows thick with violet lupines, magenta paintbrush, white bistort/valerian and small meadow daisies.

scenes.description: A new Sahale Arm/Cascade Pass-inspired ridge view into Washington's North Cascades, layered jagged glacier-cut peaks and a deep forested valley, distinct wildflower ridge foreground, visible sunbeams through broken cloud.

scenes.title: Summer mountain mist
scenes.description: An alpine meadow with a few detailed lavender lupines and muted paintbrush, rocky mountain ridges fading into thin white morning cloud, no snow-dominated winter scene.

scenes.description: A Silver Star-inspired dense native wildflower superbloom in southwest Washington, fog and dew at early morning, low warm sunbeams illuminating wet beargrass, lupines, paintbrush, bistort, daisies and penstemon above a softly layered ridge.

scenes.title: Berkeley Park Meadow Creek
scenes.description: An intimate summer meadow in Berkeley Park on Mount Rainier's north side: a clear narrow mountain creek winds through dense lavender lupines, red-magenta paintbrush and white valerian on the right; softly layered green ridges and rugged mountain slopes beyond, patchy morning clouds with gentle warm sunbeams. scenes.title: Spray Park Beargrass Sunbreak
scenes.description: A rolling meadow in Mount Rainier's Spray Park in summer: tall creamy-white beargrass flower heads interspersed with purple lupines and fresh green sedges in the right foreground, sparse dark subalpine firs, a partially cloud-wrapped Rainier massif in upper right background. Silver sunbreak just after rain, fine droplets on flowers, layered atmospheric clouds, natural rugged landscape.

scenes.title: Sunrise Ridge And White River Valley
scenes.description: Mount Rainier National Park's Sunrise area on a bright July afternoon, from a ridge looking diagonally across a deep forested White River valley toward broad volcanic Rainier in the upper right. Gnarled subalpine trees and red paintbrush dot the rocky right foreground, sparkling clean blue sky, delicate glacier striations, spacious deep view. Different elevated viewpoint from Paradise, no roads or buildings.

scenes.title: Tatoosh Peaks In Evening Light
scenes.description: Summer view of the jagged Tatoosh Range from a flower-covered meadow: multiple rugged dark peaks along the upper right horizon rather than a single round volcano, pink heather, purple penstemon, white bistort and a few lupines around finely rendered rocks in foreground. Low rose-gold evening light strikes peak faces and flower edges, cool violet-blue valleys, thin lavender clouds, serene depth.

scenes.title: Maple Pass Heather And Alpine Lake
scenes.description: A summer ridge near Maple Pass in Washington's North Cascades: a small deep blue alpine lake lies below on right, surrounded by steep rugged gray peaks and green subalpine slopes, scattered summer-green larches, clusters of delicate pink mountain heather and white wildflowers on right foreground rock. Soft clearing-cloud light, tiny high remnant snow patches, breathtaking natural depth and no buildings.

scenes.title: Mount Baker From Artist Point
scenes.description: Mount Baker from Artist Point in midsummer, white glaciated volcanic summit at upper right beyond dark green firs and rugged exposed rocky ridges; foreground patches of purple lupine and magenta heather amongst gray stones, modest remnant snowbanks only far away on high slopes. Pale peach early morning light on glaciers, cool blue shadows, airy alpine atmosphere, believable Washington scale.

scenes.title: Hurricane Ridge Lupine Slopes
scenes.description: Olympic Mountains from Hurricane Ridge in summer: a gently curving meadow slope filled with purple lupines, cream-white bistort and small meadow daisies at right, wind-shaped subalpine firs, distant jagged Olympic ridges and a deep blue forest valley. Beautiful late afternoon sun and drifting pearly cloud, small distant snowfields, warm flowers and cool mountain depth. No buildings, roads or visible crowds.

scenes.title: Goat Rocks Summer Crest
scenes.description: A flower-covered ridge in Washington's Goat Rocks Wilderness in summer: angular volcanic crags and a sweeping crest run diagonally through upper right, dense red paintbrush, lavender lupines and white flowers around dark boulders in right foreground; layers of blue-gray forested mountains beyond. A clearing summer shower gives luminous clouds and a delicate sun shaft, no goats in this landscape scene.

scenes.title: Yankee Boy Basin Columbines
scenes.description: Yankee Boy Basin in Colorado's San Juan Mountains in summer: exquisitely detailed blue-and-white Colorado columbines with long thin spurs fill a small right foreground patch, a shallow stream and gray volcanic rocks lead toward rugged brown-gray basin walls and dramatic jagged peaks on upper right. Fresh bright green meadow, clear crisp blue morning sky and thin clouds, natural small remnant high snowfields, no road or vehicles.

scenes.title: American Basin Summer Stream
scenes.description: American Basin near Handies Peak in Colorado in summer: a narrow sparkling stream winds between purple lupines, blue columbines and low alpine wildflowers on the right, a rugged amphitheater of gray-brown peaks behind lush green basin slopes. Pearly light after a gentle rain, mist only around highest distant summits, tiny ripples and wet flower detail, no tropical vegetation or giant waterfall.

scenes.title: Maroon Bells Quiet Summer Lake
scenes.description: Maroon Bells in Colorado in summer, seen from a quiet lakeside angle: distinctive layered red-maroon twin peaks rise on upper right, reflected with fresh green aspens in still water; a few soft pink wildflowers, white daisies and smooth stones along right foreground shore. Pale golden dawn, thin lavender cloud, finely painted reflection, natural mountain proportions, no boats or buildings.

scenes.title: Kebler Aspens And Sunlit Ferns
scenes.description: A different intimate interior of a giant summer aspen grove near Kebler Pass, Colorado: pale white-gray trunks with fine dark knots rise on right, lush large finely divided bracken ferns at their base and vivid fresh rounded green leaves overhead. A low shaft of late afternoon sunlight glows through translucent leaf edges and layers of forest; diagonal fallen branch and mossy stones in foreground. Green summer foliage, absolutely no orange or autumn leaves.

scenes.title: Crested Butte Meadow After Rain
scenes.description: A wide summer wildflower meadow near Crested Butte in Colorado after a passing shower: purple lupines, yellow sunflowers and golden arnica, red paintbrush, and occasional blue columbines on the right; green valley slopes and a rugged mountain silhouette farther back, faint wisps of mist over meadows. Low golden light beneath a dark lavender clearing sky, wet grass and delicate flowers sparkling, no cabins or roads.

scenes.title: Alpine Columbines In Morning Dew
scenes.description: An intimate botanical alpine-summer view: a few prominent naturally proportioned blue-and-white Colorado columbines with delicate long spurs, purple penstemon and white meadow daisies growing around finely textured granite on right foreground. Minute morning dew and gentle dappled sunlight, distant rugged San Juan ridges rendered softly on upper right. Keep botanical detail beautiful and precise; foreground close study with mountain depth, no giant oversized blooms or flower bouquet.

scenes.title: Marmot Among Alpine Rocks
scenes.description: A realistically proportioned hoary marmot resting naturally on a sun-warmed flat gray rock in a Washington alpine meadow at medium distance on right, soft grizzled gray-brown fur and relaxed posture. Small pink heather, purple lupines and fresh grasses grow between nearby talus; jagged North Cascades peaks and a glaciated ridge far behind. Gentle clear morning light, quiet natural wildlife landscape, no cartoon face, no giant close-up animal.

scenes.title: Mountain Goat In Summer Meadow
scenes.description: One realistically proportioned white mountain goat standing at medium distance on a rocky alpine ledge on the right, natural short black horns, white summer coat, anatomically credible legs and hooves. Around it delicate pink mountain heather, purple penstemon and a few red paintbrush flowers; layered rugged Washington Cascade peaks in background. Cool luminous evening light with rose glow on far peaks, no cartoon expression, no exaggerated horns or close-up face.

scenes.title: Mount Adams Fireweed And Fir Forest

A natural opening in foreground filled with tall vivid pink fireweed spikes and white beargrass, glints of golden morning light on grasses and fine flower petals, thin silver mist in a distant forested valley. Lush Pacific Northwest summer, no buildings, roads, winter landscape or autumn foliage.
